result: How do you know whether you're ready to do the harder work? This is where the familiar talk of widening your "window of tolerance" becomes practical. Titration, pendulation, and orientation each ask the same question: can you touch something difficult in a small enough dose, notice what happens, and return? How long it takes to build that capacity varies. Some people may spend three to six months mainly building these capacities, and severe developmental trauma can take longer. I would treat that as a rough guide, not a countdown. If you are stable and have one clear target, you may be ready for focused trauma work much sooner.
